summary: Tests-writing run for issue #39 (adopt generated OpenAPI client + solver parity corpus). Committed: (1) solver parity corpus mirror byte-identical to upstream viamin/color_matching priv/parity/v1/corpus.json (sha256 7b7b4d90...) plus SolverParityCorpusTests replaying all 12 scenarios against WeightedSquaredErrorScorer and CompositionSolver; (2) OpenAPI v1 wire-contract fixture (derived from the server's served spec: api_spec.ex/api_schemas.ex/color_palette_controller.ex) plus OpenAPIWireContractTests and PaletteAPIClientMigrationContractTests pinning the behavior the generated-client migration must preserve.
